statement: These inspected host components expose ALSA USB identity and PipeWire node/card properties, and Sony SDL HIDAPI drivers process joystick traffic. They provide no demonstrated automatic association between a UHID-only virtual controller and independently created PipeWire sound nodes lacking shared USB ancestry. The feasibility of auto-discovery by a specific SDL/Steam/Proton consumer remains unknown; explicit application-level pairing and actual consumer probes are required before a shape-A automatic-routing claim.

applicability.scope: Synthesis of bounded file inspections only. No assertion that matching via custom policy, user routing or external applications is impossible.
